title: WPSS/430/2023 of REKHA KAPRI Vs ARMY WELFARE EDUCATION SOCIETY THROUGH ITS CHAIRMAN

paras.text:

COURT'S OR JUDGES'S ORDERS
WPSS No.430 of 2023
Hon'ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
1. Mr. Kamal Kishore Harbola, learned
counsel for the petitioner.
2. Mr. Amit Kapri, learned counsel for the
caveator/respondents.
3. Heard learned counsel for the parties.
4. It is submitted by learned counsel for the
caveator/respondents that pleadings have been
exchanged by him and substantial amount has
been spent by the respondents.
5. Petitioner has moved Withdrawal Appl.
No.04 of 2024 for withdrawal of writ petition
with liberty to file fresh with better particulars.
6. Since petitioner is master of his case,
therefore, withdrawal application is permitted to
be allowed.
7. Accordingly, withdrawal application is
allowed with aforesaid liberty subject to the
cost of Rs.5,000/- to be deposited in the High
Court Bar Association Advocates Welfare Fund.
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.)
 30.04.2024
